data.one_liner: Pedometer and step detection plugin for Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides step counts over time ranges, real-time step streaming, and pedestrian status updates using device sensors. Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to track user steps and walking activity in real-time.
You want to retrieve historical step counts over specific date ranges.
avoid_when: Your target Android devices run versions older than Android 10 (minSDK level 29).
You require guaranteed step counting across all hardware models without sensor compatibility issues.
strengths: Provides real-time step streams and pedestrian status.
Allows querying step count for specific date ranges.
weaknesses: Certain manufacturers or older phones may lack necessary sensor support.
First-time usage after installation returns 0 steps.
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration including Info.plist motion usage description and Podfile updates for iOS, and minimum Android 10, Gradle 8.4, and Kotlin 1.9.10 for Android.
